about.title: About Me
about.text: A passionate and proficient Software Engineer and Full Stack Developer with a strong foundation in both front-end and back-end technologies. I specialize in creating scalable, responsive, and optimized web applications using React.js, Next.js, Node.js, and Python. My expertise extends to database management with MySQL and MongoDB, as well as Technical SEO and API integrations. I excel at transforming design requirements into high-quality, user-friendly interfaces and streamlining business workflows through secure backend solutions. I am always eager to learn and adapt to new technologies to drive innovation and efficiency.

skills.title: My Skills
skills.skills_summary: With a strong foundation in Full Stack development, I am proficient in modern JavaScript frameworks like React.js and Next.js, as well as backend technologies including Node.js and Python. I have extensive experience in database management, API integrations, and Technical SEO, ensuring robust and scalable web solutions.

services.title: Services I Offer
services.services_summary: I offer comprehensive web development services, ranging from Full Stack application development to UI/UX implementation and Technical SEO. I build scalable solutions that streamline operations and enhance user experience.

experience.title: Experience
experience.summary: With a solid background as an HTML Developer, Front End Developer, and UI Developer, I have a proven track record of developing and maintaining web pages and applications. My experience spanned across various companies, where I honed my skills in front-end technologies. I collaborated effectively with cross-functional teams, including React, WordPress, and Shopify developers, providing high-quality HTML and SCSS to build modern and responsive websites.
